name: Microsoft Foundry Chat Model
category_description: AI cluster sub-node (model, memory, tool, parser)
description: The Microsoft Foundry Chat Model node connects conversational agents[^1] to the chat models on your Microsoft Foundry or Azure OpenAI resource

parameters.name: Authentication
parameters.description: Choose API Key or Azure Entra ID (OAuth2). Each option uses its own credential

parameters.name: Project
parameters.description: Enter the name of the Microsoft Foundry project that owns the deployment. Leave it empty to use the Project from the credential. A classic Azure OpenAI resource doesn't use it

parameters.name: Model (Deployment)
parameters.description: Select the deployment to use to generate the completion

parameters.name: Model Family
parameters.description: Choose the API family the deployment uses. Azure doesn't report this, so set it to match your deployment

parameters.name: Use Responses API
parameters.description: Choose which API the node calls for an OpenAI family deployment. This needs a credential that uses the Microsoft Foundry endpoint type

parameters.name: Frequency Penalty
parameters.description: Use this option to control the chances of the model repeating itself. Higher values reduce the chance of the model repeating itself

parameters.name: Maximum Number of Tokens
parameters.description: Enter the maximum number of tokens used, which sets the completion length

parameters.name: Response Format
parameters.description: Choose Text or JSON. JSON ensures the model returns valid JSON

parameters.name: Presence Penalty
parameters.description: Use this option to control the chances of the model talking about new topics. Higher values increase the chance of the model talking about new topics

parameters.name: Sampling Temperature
parameters.description: Use this option to control the randomness of the sampling process. A higher temperature creates more diverse sampling, but increases the risk of hallucinations. The maximum is 2 for the OpenAI model family and 1 for the Anthropic model family

parameters.name: Timeout
parameters.description: Enter the maximum request time in milliseconds

parameters.name: Max Retries
parameters.description: Enter the maximum number of times to retry a request

parameters.name: Top P
parameters.description: Use this option to set the probability the completion should use. Use a lower value to ignore less probable options

parameters.name: Extra Body
parameters.description: Enter extra JSON properties to add to the request body. Use this for parameters that your deployment supports and the other options don't cover. The value must be a JSON object

parameters.name: project
parameters.description: The Microsoft Foundry project that owns the deployment. Leave empty to use the project from the credential. A classic Azure OpenAI resource does not use it.

parameters.name: model
parameters.description: The deployment to use. Choose from the list (Microsoft Foundry credentials only), or enter the deployment name.

parameters.name: modelFamily
parameters.description: The API family the deployment answers on. Azure does not report this, so set it to match the deployment: OpenAI for GPT and other OpenAI-compatible models, Anthropic for Claude. Anthropic needs a credential using the Azu

parameters.name: responsesApiEnabled
parameters.description: Whether to call the deployment on the Responses API instead of Chat Completions. Azure does not tell us which one a deployment supports, so set this to match your deployment: leave it off for a chat-completions deploymen

parameters.name: options

options.name: frequencyPenalty
options.description: Positive values penalize new tokens based on their existing frequency in the text so far, decreasing the model's likelihood to repeat the same line verbatim

options.name: maxTokens
options.description: The maximum number of tokens to generate in the completion. Most models have a context length of 2048 tokens (except for the newest models, which support 32,768

options.name: presencePenalty
options.description: Positive values penalize new tokens based on whether they appear in the text so far, increasing the model's likelihood to talk about new topics

options.name: temperature
options.description: Controls randomness: Lowering results in less random completions. As the temperature approaches zero, the model will become deterministic and repetitive.
